title: 3dInvFMRI
description: Program to compute stimulus time series, given a 3D+time dataset and an activation map (the inverse of the usual FMRI analysis problem).

activation_map.description: Defines activation map; should be a bucket dataset where each sub-brick defines the beta weight map for an unknown stimulus time series.
activation_map.title: Activation map

map_weight.description: Defines a weighting factor for the map. Dataset can have either 1 sub-brick or the same number as in the -map dataset.
map_weight.title: Map weight

mask.description: Defines a mask dataset to restrict input voxels from -data and -map.
mask.title: Mask dataset

baseline_file.description: Baseline time series file. Each column of the file defines a baseline time series.
baseline_file.title: Baseline file

polynom_order.description: Adds polynomials of specified order to the baseline collection.
polynom_order.title: Polynomial order

method.description: Determines the method to use: C for least squares fit to data matrix (default) or K for least squares fit to activation matrix.
method.title: Method

alpha.description: Set the alpha factor to penalize large values of the output vectors.
alpha.title: Alpha factor

smooth_fir.description: Smooth the results with a 5 point lowpass FIR filter.
smooth_fir.title: 5 point FIR filter

smooth_median.description: Smooth the results with a 5 point median filter.
smooth_median.title: 5 point median filter
